notes: LoC IIIF serves these negatives only up to the 1024 px service image (larger requests are upscaled), so hi-res pieces were cut from the master TIFFs with HTTP Range requests over only the needed rows/columns (test-shot-build/tiffcrop.py); ~63 MB fetched in all.
